_about: The single source of truth for this platform: what it accepts and what we have learned about it. Every skill, job and script that makes or posts videos for it reads this file; put new findings here, not anywhere else. maxSeconds is the platform's limit. A video longer than that never goes out cut: the video build makes a separate version for this platform of at most versionSeconds, with its own hook, payoff and end card (data.versions.<platform>), and the publisher posts it only when that version exists.
notes: Shorts up to 3 minutes; documentaries are 16:9 long-form and are never cut.
API uploads go out public (since 2026-11-16; Google confirmed API uploads are not forced private).
Upload quota is about 6 videos a day by the old estimate, reset at 13:30 IST; in practice 9 uploads on 16 Nov 2026 all went through.

Posting times (IST) are the same 5 as Instagram (one publish run posts to every platform); see the reasoning in instagram.json. India Shorts guides (Fluxnote) also name 7-9 AM and 7-9 PM IST. 5 uploads a day fit the quota: 9 uploads on 16 Nov 2026 all succeeded.
